Title: General availability: Azure Data Factory in China East 2

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory (ADF) is now generally available in Azure China (China East 2). You can see the full list of available and upcoming regions here.

Azure Data Factory is a fully-managed hybrid data integration service for developing scalable extract/transform/load and extract/load/transform (ETL/ELT) data pipelines. It empowers you to:

  • Ingest data from over 80 data sources, on-premises or in the cloud, with a simple drag-and-drop experience and first-class high performance;
  • Integrate with broad Azure analytics and compute services for custom data transformation, e.g. HDInsight, Function, Azure Batch, etc.;
  • Take advantage of your existing investments in your on-premises SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and lift-and-shift into Azure;
  • Operationalize and manage the ETL/ELT flows with flexible control flow;
  • Leverage the rich monitoring as well as continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) capabilities.

For more information, see the Azure Data Factory documentation for China region and Azure Data Factory overview.
